notes.title: Escape Room VR: Stories — check our latest update!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Explorers![/b]

It's been two years since we published Escape Room VR: Stories. It looked as the game story was finished. It is true that due to some changes, we couldn't work up to date. But since now, we fixed that! 

We have read all the reviews and start working on the new updates. 
In the latest version, you can find below changes:
— Fix for Oculus Rift related to hand controllers;
— New kind of moving - smooth locomotion;
— Teleportation by trackpad is changed, it's more user friendly;
— Dozens of minor improvements.

The new story begins. We will do our best to make regular updates and be closer to you, puzzle-game lovers. In the next one, we will add new comics and Steam achievements.

If you would like to give us some suggestions, participate in game development and create new rooms, please join our [b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DQa2m45]Discord[/url][/b] and stay online with us!

Thank you for being with us!
Leszek from PunkPirates
